title: Kamailio World 2020 – A Preview Of Sessions
html:
Today were published the details of many sessions accepted for Kamailio World Conference 2020, a couple more will be added in the next days.

You can see them at:

  • https://www.kamailioworld.com/k08/schedule/

In parallel has been started the process of creating the full agenda for the three days of the event, during April 27-29, 2020.

The topics cover many areas of interest for real time communications, from security to scalability, VoLTE and 5G, WebRTC, IoT, API driven systems, monitoring agents and next generation emergency services. The major open source projects, Kamailio, Asterisk and FreeSwitch, are well represented again, with speakers coming from more than a dozen of countries.

There is no reason not to expect another edition with excellent technical content about RTC and great opportunities for networking! See you in Berlin!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
